name: Architecture Visualizer
description: Single-page React app for authoring and navigating layered architecture diagrams. Two modes in one app — Present (read-only) and Editor (tree-shakeable). No backend in v1; projects load from public/projects/*.json and editor drafts live in localStorage.

diagrams.name: System context
diagrams.description: Top-level view. Drill into the SPA for internal layering.

nodes.name: Architect / consumer
nodes.description: Solutions Architects author diagrams; devs, BAs, OPS, and QA navigate them like a map.

nodes.name: Vite + projects-plugin
nodes.description: Vite dev/build with the custom projects-plugin: validates project JSON with Zod at build time, emits manifest.json + search-index.json. Structural errors fail the build (ADR-0002).

nodes.name: Architecture Visualizer (SPA)
nodes.description: React 18 + TypeScript SPA built with Vite. React Flow canvas, Zustand state, react-router-dom v6. Drill in for internal layering.

nodes.name: Bundled project JSON
nodes.description: public/projects/*.json — one file per project plus generated manifest.json and search-index.json. Source of truth for Present mode.

nodes.name: Browser localStorage
nodes.description: Editor draft autosave at key `arcviz:draft:<projectId>` (ADR-0004). Present mode never reads from here.

nodes.name: File system / downloads
nodes.description: File System Access API (where available) and browser download fallback. Used for Export JSON and Import JSON in the editor.

diagrams.name: SPA internals
diagrams.description: How the visualizer SPA is layered. Routing shell on the left, single persistent canvas in the middle, lib modules underneath.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.description: App entry. Mounts React, the theme provider, and the router.

nodes.name: Router
nodes.description: react-router-dom v6 BrowserRouter. URL is the source of truth on cold load. Editor routes (`/edit/*`) are absent when VITE_EDITOR_ENABLED=false.

nodes.name: Shell
nodes.description: Top-level layout: command palette, mode toggle, theme switcher, breadcrumb. Mounts the persistent canvas once (ADR-0006).

nodes.name: NavigationController
nodes.description: Single owner of the semantic back-stack (ADR-0003). All in-app navigation routes through here; stack rides in history.state.

nodes.name: Routed pages
nodes.description: Home, DiagramPage, EditorView (lazy), TourView, ProjectRedirect, NotFound. EditorView is dynamically imported so it tree-shakes out of the Present-only build.

nodes.name: CanvasHost (React Flow)
nodes.description: Single persistent <ReactFlow> instance — never keyed on diagramId. Custom node/edge components; per-diagram viewport cached in the store (ADR-0006).

nodes.name: Present UI
nodes.description: Read-only chrome: DetailDrawer, Breadcrumb, FilterBar, CapturePngButton, CommandPalette (Fuse.js).

nodes.name: Editor UI
nodes.description: NodePalette, PropertiesPanel, ValidationPanel, EditorTopBar, NewProjectDialog. Tree-shaken from the Present-only bundle (ADR-0010).

nodes.name: Zustand store
nodes.description: Projects (validated), nav stack, selection, viewports, pulse target, editor history (50-entry snapshot stack — ADR-0009). Only holds Zod-validated Project objects.

nodes.name: Loader + Zod schema
nodes.description: projectLoader fetches manifest.json + per-project JSON, runs lib/schema (Zod) + three-tier validation in lib/loader, applies migrations. Only the validated Project shape reaches the store (ADR-0007).

nodes.name: Serializer + drafts
nodes.description: lib/persistence canonical serializer (deterministic key order, 2-space indent) — the single producer of stored JSON. lib/drafts owns localStorage autosave keyed by commit() boundaries (ADR-0004 / ADR-0009).

nodes.name: Auto-layout (elkjs)
nodes.description: elkjs adapter in lib/autoLayout. Dynamically imported only when the editor invokes Layout → Auto-arrange so elkjs stays out of the Present bundle (ADR-0005).
